title: Varieties of Religious Experience
author: William James
hook: You pray every night hoping for peace.

sections.title: Story
sections.narration: You pray every night hoping for peace. Ancient philosophers argued true peace comes from inner experience, not ritual. In 2001, neuroscientist Andrew Newberg at Penn scanned meditators in about 12 scans. The result? He found reduced activity in the parietal lobe, a sign of self‑transcendence. In 2014, Pew surveyed about 3,000 Americans and found roughly 20% reported mystical moments. So why do we assume prayer alone rewires the brain? Because focused meditation, not words, triggers measurable brain change. That's it. You pray every night hoping for peace.
